extDescription.message: A growing timer in front of time-sink sites: the more often you visit, the longer you wait.

gateHint.message: The circle only fills while this tab is visible and focused.

gateVisitLine.message: Visit $P1$ today. Sure there is something new in there?

popupFootnote.message: Visits today · current price of entry

popupNotListedWhy.message: Add the domain in settings and press Save.

popupInSession.message: You are inside a session: navigation in this tab is free. A new entry in another tab — $P1$.

popupReturnFree.message: Returning to the session is free for another $P1$, after that — $P2$.

optSub.message: The more often you visit, the longer you wait. The visit counter decays on its own; there is no daily reset.

optFreeVisitsHint.message: This many visits in a row with no timer at all.

optBaseSecHint.message: Timer length on the first paid visit.

optGrowthHint.message: How much more expensive each next visit gets.

optCapHint.message: The timer never grows beyond this. Endless growth = a block = a relapse.

optTauHint.message: A visit’s weight drops about 2.7× over this time. Higher = stricter.

optCooldownHint.message: Coming back within this time is not a new visit.

optSessionMaxHint.message: After this long since the session started, coming back is a new visit — even a quick one.

optSharedPool.message: Shared counter for all sites (otherwise rotating is easy: Reddit is done, off to YouTube)

optSitesNote.message: One domain per line, without www. Subdomains count automatically (old.reddit.com → reddit.com).

optSitesNotStored.message: the site list was not saved
